headline: EEC describes advantages of trade agreement with Mongolia
summary: The provisional trade agreement with Mongolia will allow businesses to save tens of millions of dollars annually on customs duties, a Eurasian Economic Commission board member said.
why: Customs duty reductions under trade agreements lower costs for cross-border trade, affecting exporters and importers in the signatory economies.
